IPAD_TOUCH_ENHANCER.ModuleDescription: Optimizes Foundry VTT v13 for iPadOS/iOS Safari: Adds a draggable double-click/right-click mini-bar, fixes for window clipping and duplicate checkboxes, and more.

EnableModule.Name: Enable module
EnableModule.Hint: Master switch to enable or disable all features and visual fixes of this module for your client.

EnableTouchBar.Name: Double-click / Right-click mini-bar
EnableTouchBar.Hint: Adds a draggable mini-bar to emulate double-click and right-click actions, with a toggle button in the Scene Controls bar to control its visibility.

EnableSingleTapHud.Name: Token HUD on Short Tap
EnableSingleTapHud.Hint: Opens the Token HUD on a short tap of a token.

EnableHudSheetButton.Name: Actor Sheet Button
EnableHudSheetButton.Hint: Adds a button to the Token HUD that opens the selected token’s Actor Sheet.

HideHudElevationArrow.Name: Hide Caret (^)
HideHudElevationArrow.Hint: Removes the system datalist dropdown indicator (^) rendered by iPadOS Safari over the token elevation field.

FixSafariWindows.Name: Fix Application Window Clipping
FixSafariWindows.Hint: Adjusts application window positioning to prevent clipping at the bottom of the screen.

FixSafariInputs.Name: Fix Duplicate Checkboxes
FixSafariInputs.Hint: Prevents checkboxes from appearing twice in the interface.
